'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes]]
**[[Tajikistan]] says that a [[border conflict|border clash]] happened yesterday after [[Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz]] soldiers crossed the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|border]] close to [[Vorukh]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/tajikistan-accuses-kyrgyzstan-provoking-latest-border-clash-2022-06-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Hapur chemical plant explosion]]
**Nine people are killed and 19 others injured after a [[boiler]] explodes at a [[chemical plant]] in [[Hapur]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-asia-new-delhi-fires-bdee4d0b0ef331f0d7fa7a15f136ac0b (AP)]
*One person is killed and eight others injured when a train [[derails]] in [[Guizhou]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-guangzhou-accidents-c179ac127bdb823b07cd32bd0a4f24ab (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
***[[Dmitry Kovtun]], a former [[KGB]] agent accused of [[Poisoning of Alexander Litvinenko|the fatal 2006 poisoning]] of [[opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|Kremlin critic]] [[Alexander Litvinenko]] in [[London]], dies from [[COVID-19]] in [[Moscow]]. [https://www.rferl.org/amp/kovtun-dead-litvinnenko-poisoning-covid/31883349.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Timeline of the 2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
***[[India]] reports its first suspected [[monkeypox]] case in a girl from [[Ghaziabad]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/noida-news/ghaziabad-doctors-suspect-monkeypox-like-symptoms-in-girl-101654282463323.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Philadelphia shooting]]
**Three people are killed and eleven others wounded in a [[mass shooting]] in the [[South Street (Philadelphia)|South Street]] neighbourhood of [[Philadelphia]], [[Pennsylvania]], United States. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/least-three-dead-philadelphia-latest-us-mass-shooting-2022-06-05/ (Reuters)]
*A man is publicly [[lynched]] by a mob of 200 people in the [[Nigeria]]n [[capital city]] [[Abuja]] after he gets into a "heated argument" with a local [[Islam]]ic cleric. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-man-burned-death-after-argument-with-muslim-cleric-2022-06-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Albanian presidential election]]
**After three sessions in which the proposed candidates failed to obtain the necessary votes, the [[Parliament of Albania]] elects [[Chief of the General Staff (Albania)|Chief of the General Staff]] [[Bajram Begaj]] as the new [[President of Albania|Albanian President]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/albanian-army-chief-voted-new-president-2022-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021–2022 Tunisian political crisis]]
**The [[Tunisia]]n judiciary announces that it will suspend work in all of the courts and go on [[strike action|strike]] for a week in response to [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]] dismissing 57 [[judge]]s earlier this week. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisian-judges-suspend-work-courts-week-after-president-fired-57-judges-2022-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*The Judicial Council for [[Iraq]]'s [[Kurdistan Region]] rejects a ruling from the [[Supreme Judicial Council of Iraq|federal Supreme Judicial Council]] demanding that the [[Kurdistan Regional Government|regional government]] hand over its oil supply, stating that the oil-sharing agreement enshrined in the [[Constitution of Iraq|national constitution]] did not apply to oil and gas discovered after 2005. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/iraqs-kurdistan-judicial-council-defies-supreme-court-over-oil-law-2022-06-04/ (Reuters)] 

'''Sports'''
*[[Japanese people|Japanese]] [[Yachting|yachtsman]] [[Kenichi Horie]] becomes the oldest person to sail solo across the [[Pacific Ocean]] at the age of 83. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2022/06/04/national/kenichi-horie-oldest-solo-nonstop-pacific-ocean-sailing/ (''The Japan Times'')]
